objective: Make public Wall comments render on initial data response instead of blocking on reaction, name and cluster metadata, and preserve account-scoped security under weak networks.
productionBaselineEvidence: Read-only inspection of protected main commit 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f on 2026-11-22, not proof of live OTA content.
chosenApproach: Render authorized comment RPC rows first, enrich reactions and labels asynchronously, keep a six-entry 15-second account-specific presentation cache, and purge authorization-revoked cache.
selectionRationale: The existing comments UI awaited parallel reactions and 5-second enrichments before painting returned text, adding avoidable latency and turning ancillary failures into visible delays.
preserveBehaviors: Retain user/post authorization via get_buklod_post_comments_v4 and the existing sender/owner permissions.
Retain replies, original ordering, reactions, reports, delete/edit, GIF and photo composer, profile routing and authenticated display.
Keep public Wall comments AdMob placement, viewport rules, offline/retry feedback, prior layout compactness, feed navigation and no forced full feed refresh.
Never expose cached comments after account switch or access denial; no storage persistence of comment content.
acceptanceChecks: Node regression contracts must pass on CI, including navigation/ownership/first-paint/weak-network and ad-preservation checks.
Protected-feature-lock and engineering-regression-gate must accept this isolated manifest without bypass.
No Supabase schema/RLS, package native, release, OTA publishing or unrelated web change.
Manual Android latency/runtime behavior remains unverified until separately performed.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Change the public Wall comment loader's asynchronous sequencing and memory cache while preserving rendering, ads and composer behavior.
preservedBehaviors: Comment text is still loaded under existing authorized RPC; reactions remain functional, retries stay available and data is not persisted across sign-ins.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: The primary public Wall tab module is protected navigation/auth surface; account, post and request identity checks need regression proof.
preservedBehaviors: All account switches invalidate comment cache, post IDs remain isolated, profile/navigation callbacks are preserved, and explicit permission denial purges warm content.

alternativeApproaches: Create a privileged unified comments-and-reactions RPC (rejected: changes backend/security without evidence and adds risk).
Increase timeouts without reordering hydration (rejected: does not improve first text paint).
Store comment content in persistent offline cache (rejected: unnecessary privacy and account-isolation risk).
releaseTarget: future staging candidate after full gates
